question: Who among the following is known as the ‘Shehnai maestro’ ?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ustad Bismillah Khan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Ustad Bismillah Khan** is considered one of the greatest shehnai players in the world.
 
• He was born on March 21, 1916, in Bhirung Raut Ki Gali, Dumraon, Bihar.
 
• He was awarded India's highest civilian honors including the Bharat Ratna in 2001.
 
• Ustad Bismillah Khan was instrumental in bringing the shehnai to the center stage of Indian classical music.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Shehnai**

 
 
• The shehnai is a double-reed instrument, similar to the oboe, and is commonly used in North Indian classical music.
 
• It is often played during auspicious occasions such as weddings and temple festivals.
 
• The sound of the shehnai is considered to be very auspicious and is believed to create a sense of well-being and prosperity.
 
 
 
• **Ustad Bismillah Khan's Contributions**
 
 
• He popularized the shehnai and brought it into the limelight of Indian classical music.
 
• His performances have graced various prestigious platforms including the All India Radio and the Indian Independence Day celebration in 1947.
 
• He has been honored with numerous awards such as the Padma Shri, Padma Bhushan, Padma Vibhushan, and the Bharat Ratna.
 
• Ustad Bismillah Khan's legacy continues to inspire many young musicians to take up the shehnai.
 
 
 
• **Other Notable Musicians**
 
 
• **Ustad Bade Ghulam Ali Khan** - A legendary Hindustani classical vocalist of the Patiala gharana.
 
• **Hariprasad Chaurasia** - A renowned classical flautist in India, known for his extraordinary expertise in the bansuri (bamboo flute).
 
• **Ustad Amjad Ali Khan** - A distinguished sarod player, known for his contributions to Indian classical music.
